description: One entry per in-scope CurriculumPlan with a matching period component, populated by ReportCardComposer from FinalGrade.breakdown.periods[periodCode]. A subject whose CurriculumPlan declares no component matching the ReportPeriod's periodCode contributes no row here (not an error).

courseId.description: UUID of the associated Course, when set on the source FinalGrade.
courseId.title: Course ID

periodAverage.description: The FinalGrade.breakdown.periods[periodCode] value for this subject at composition time.
periodAverage.title: Period Average

passed.description: The source FinalGrade.passed value for this subject at composition time.
passed.title: Passed

teacherComment.description: Per-subject teacher comment, editable while the report card is in draft or rapportvergadering-review.
teacherComment.title: Teacher Comment

sourceGradeEntryIds.description: UUIDs of the published GradeEntries that contributed this subject's periodAverage, denormalised the same way AttendanceFlag.breachingRecordIds already is — so ReportCardVisibilityGuard can resolve each entry's visibleFrom without a second query hop.
sourceGradeEntryIds.title: Source Grade Entry IDs

title: Subject Grades
